name: Divine risk

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Pargod (Cosmic Veil) separating the emanated light from the absolute essence

VINIT.justification: The infinite, undifferentiated state prior to any contraction or emanation

TANCH.justification: The final vessel that contains and manifests the divine light within the physical world

AFWD.justification: The downward flow of divine light from the source toward the lower worlds

AREV.justification: The return of sparks or consciousness from the lower worlds back to the source

CLINK.justification: The sequential connection of divine attributes where one emanation causes the next

IMSCRIB.justification: The crown that represents the divine will and the identity of the source within the system

FSPLIT.justification: The contraction that creates a void, splitting the infinite light into specific vessels and potential paths

FFUSE.justification: The restoration process that gathers the scattered light back into a unified divine structure

EVALT.justification: The branch of expansive mercy and affirmative divine presence

EVALF.justification: The branch of restrictive judgment and the risk of total concealment

ENGAGR.justification: The balance point that holds mercy and judgment in simultaneous tension

IFIX.justification: The permanent impression or trace left in the void after the light withdraws

phase_3.void_description: The pre-creation state of absolute non-differentiation
phase_3.true_description: The manifestation of divine grace and revelation
phase_3.false_description: The state of exile, concealment, and the risk of the 'Other Side'
phase_3.both_description: The paradoxical coexistence of divine presence and divine absence within the same space

steps.domain_action: The infinite light exists in a state of absolute potentiality
The divine will emerges as the primary identity of the system
The contraction occurs to create a space for finite existence
The right pillar of mercy extends to sustain the creation
Light flows into the higher vessels of wisdom and understanding
The emanations link together to form the structural skeleton of the universe
The first vessels shatter, leaving a permanent record of the catastrophe
The left pillar of judgment restricts the light to prevent total dissolution
The sparks begin their ascent through the broken structures
The central pillar holds the tension between mercy and judgment
The restoration process reunites the scattered sparks with their source
The divine presence finds a permanent dwelling in the final vessel

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Logos or Primordial Torah that translates divine intent into structural laws
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The 22 Hebrew letters acting as the conduits for information transfer between sefirot
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Akasha or the celestial records that store every action and its spiritual consequence
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The cosmic cycles of Shemitot that determine the timing of emanation and withdrawal
phase_5.alfs_store: The Tree of Life as the canonical blueprint for all possible states

phase_6.cycle_cost: The expenditure of divine light required to maintain the illusion of separation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system returns all light to the source, preserving the total energy of the Ein Sof
